posts.text: Tonight, we had the privilege of launching Heritage’s inaugural Edwin J. Feulner Lecture on what would have been my late mentor and friend’s 85th birthday. In the daily social and political fights, it’s easy to lose the long-term perspective. Thinking of Ed the institution-builder reminds me that it’s institutions—beginning with the family and extending to local communities, churches, and places like @Heritage—that matter most for preserving liberty for America’s next 250 years.

Grateful to @michaeljknowles for joining me for the 20th anniversary celebration of John Paul the Great Academy, which I founded in 2007.

Congratulations to all the students, faculty, administrators, priests, friends, and supporters who’ve made the first 20 years so successful. God has rewarded their faithfulness.

May the zeal and cheerfulness of our patron, Saint John Paul II, continue to guide everyone associated with the school.
